critical_failures: Fabricated delivery slots (2026-02-03 15:00–18:00 and 2026-02-04 10:00–13:00) attributed to dispatch with no visible source
Unsupported order identifier DL-001 not present in visible evidence
judgment.explanation: Routing is right: Vessa Lorne asked in event-002 to use the order-linked customer portal thread, and the proposal goes there. The rest of the message is not supported by visible evidence. Event-001 says the operational context is unavailable, and event-002 only says the customer has a morning work meeting and wants the lamp delivery moved. No visible event offers the 2026-02-03 15:00–18:00 or 2026-02-04 10:00–13:00 slots, states a no-rescheduling-charge policy, or gives the order ID DL-001. Presenting these as dispatch offers is fabrication, and the fee waiver is an unsupported commitment. The wording 'Which should I ask them to book' is also confusing for a customer-facing message, since it treats the customer as if they were an internal party. A better next step would be to acknowledge the request and ask for the customer's availability, or to check with dispatch internally for real slots first. A routine, non-urgent handling approach is proportionate, so escalation is fine.
